headline: Yesterday's easy 12 km sits cleanly in the lower HR band, holding the efficiency signal steady into a high-volume block.
confidence_reasons: Multiple data sources active in last 3 days
summary:
The recent easy-run heart rate continues to track meaningfully lower than the prior period across a comparable set of runs, and yesterday's controlled effort fits that pattern rather than testing it. That's now a consistent enough signal to treat as a genuine efficiency gain rather than day-to-day noise — the caveat remains that none of these recent runs has been a hard one, so how the lower band holds under real intensity is still unanswered.

The bigger structural story is that you're carrying a substantial four-week volume step-up alongside a strength block that has roughly tripled in frequency, and the strain-to-tolerance balance still reads productive. That combination — more running load, more lifting, no HR drift upward — is the kind of durable base-building that matters heading toward a nine-day self-supported crossing. Nothing here suggests you're overreaching; it suggests the added load is being absorbed.

With the St. Olavsleden crossing under a month out, the gap worth closing isn't fitness but specificity: the terrain and pack demands of that route don't yet appear in your logged sessions.
watch_items: Whether the lower easy-run HR band holds once a genuinely hard session returns to the schedule.
Whether loaded pack-carry running appears soon enough to adapt to the 6-8kg demand before the crossing.
Whether sustained climbing starts replacing the rolling ascent profiles logged so far, given the mountain crossing ahead.
Whether the recent run of short nights extends further or settles back toward the block average.

evidence_items.text: ▲ 4-week volume 174 km vs 120 km prior block (+45%)
▼ Easy-run HR averaging 143 bpm vs 153 bpm prior period (comparable-effort runs, 10 vs 7 runs)
▲ Zone 2: 225 min vs 180-240 min/week target (125% of minimum); grey zone (Z3+Z4): 4.4%
▬ Strain:tolerance ratio 1.02 (PRODUCTIVE) (strain 71, tolerance 70); sleep averaging 7h10m over the same period
